freeze_record.what: FREEZE of the post-hoc unit normalizer v2 (src/unit_norm_fix_v2.py) before any held-out evaluation data exists
freeze_record.statement: unit_norm_fix_v2.py was developed (post hoc) on data/journal2/unf_adversarial.jsonl (the synthetic unit-spelling adversarial set) and is FROZEN from this commit on. The held-out set (data/journal2/unf_heldout.jsonl, built from real LLM-answer and openFDA-label dose strings) is created only AFTER this freeze commit; v2 must not be edited afterwards. Bugs found on the held-out set are reported, not fixed. Verify with: sha256sum src/unit_norm_fix_v2.py
